messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Ozempic Dosing Information:
Ozempic Injection Recommended Dosage:
Start Ozempic with a 0.25 mg subcutaneous injection (injection under the skin) once weekly for 4 weeks.
The 0.25 mg dosage is intended for treatment initiation.
It is not effective for glycemic control.
After 4 weeks on the 0.25 mg dosage, increase the dosage to 0.5 mg once weekly.
If additional glycemic control is needed after at least 4 weeks on the 0.5 mg dosage.
The dosage may be increased to 1 mg once weekly.
If additional glycemic control is needed after at least 4 weeks on the 1 mg dosage.
The dosage may be increased to 2 mg once weekly.
The maximum recommended dosage is 2 mg once weekly.
Administer Ozempic once weekly, on the same day each week, at any time of the day, with or without meals.
The day of weekly administration can be changed if necessary.
The time between two doses must be at least 2 days (>48 hours).
If a dose is missed, administer Ozempic as soon as possible within 5 days after the missed dose.
If more than 5 days have passed, skip the missed dose.
Triplet: ["Ozempic", "has dosage escalation instruction", "increase to 2 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 1 mg"]

The relation 'has dosage escalation instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's dosage may be increased to the specified amount after a defined period of time on the current dosage.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dose increment': The subject drug's dose is increased by the specified amount at regular intervals.
B. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified in the object entity.
C. 'peak levels occur at': The subject drug reaches its peak concentration in the blood at the time period specified by the object entity.
D. 'increases level of': The subject drug increases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
E. 'has onset of effect': The subject drug starts to work or shows its effect within the time period specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
